# INC-4821 — Payment batch partially rejected

**Status:** resolved
**Severity:** major
**Created:** 2026-07-26
**Resolved:** 2026-07-28

## Summary

The overnight payment batch was partially rejected by the clearing house. 214 of
1,830 instructions were returned unprocessed and had to be resubmitted by hand.

## Impact

Finance confirmed a total exposure CHF 48'200 in late-settlement interest and
manual reprocessing effort. Two systems were affected: payments-api and the
ledger-batch job.

## Investigation

The clearing house reported a malformed field in the affected instructions. The
originating defect was not identified before the incident was closed.
